images.caption: # <sb>Food Allergens, Intolerances, and General Information for Customers</sb>
## **Allergens **are foods known to **cause reactions in allergic people** due to an immune response. Some people react to food containing allergens.
## People's **reactions** to food allergens **vary **but can be severe and even life-threatening. Some people can react severely to even the smallest trace of certain allergenic foods.
## Our goal is to **protect customers** with food allergies by avoiding cross-contamination and providing accurate information about the food or ingredients.
## ** Front counter** team members are **NOT **responsible for deciding if the customer's ingredient references are related to serious health problems.
## However, front counter members are responsible for **providing accurate information** about product ingredients so customers can make informed choices.
## At Roll'd, we provide our customers with the '**Nitty Gritty**', which contains our Nutritional Information and Gluten-Free items. *Look at the 'Nitty Gritty' document in the briefcase.*
## However, please note that all our **menu items may contain traces of gluten** as we use the same facility to prepare our non-gluten-free items.
## For Nut/Dairy-Free options: The team can locate the ingredients and allergen information on each **product's label**.

list.content: ## Only purchase stock from **Roll'd approved suppliers**.
list.title: Purchase

list.content: ## Inspect all **food deliveries**. Observe whether the driver and the truck are clean and check that the vehicle is not carrying animals or chemicals in the same area as the food. Only receive stock in good condition, with enough time to sell or use it before the 'best before' or 'use by' dates.
list.title: Inspect

list.content: ## Reject products immediately if: * in damaged packaging * close to using by date and/or out of date * if contaminated * delivered at the wrong temperature (e.g., high-risk products delivered in the temperature danger zone between 5-60C)
list.title: Reject

list.content: ## Complete temperature check for all deliveries of **high-risk products** using a thermometer.
list.title: Temperature Check

list.content: ## Report to the supply chain immediately if there are any **product issues** (providing product name, photos, batch number).
list.title: Report
